record.original_question: Give an example of a smooth projective curve X over a field of characteristic p > 0 together with a finite group action rho: G -> Aut(X) such that, for the deformation hull R(X, rho), the characteristic nu(X, rho) equals p^n for some finite n > 1.

evidence.quote: Problem 3.1 Give an example of a group action (X, rho) such that nu(X, rho) = p^n for n > 1 finite.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic $p>0$, and let $X$ be a smooth projective connected curve over $k$. Let $G$ be a finite group and $\rho:G\hookrightarrow\mathrm{Aut}_k(X)$ a faithful action of $G$ on $X$. Consider the equivariant deformation functor $D_{X,\rho}$ on the category of complete local Noetherian $W(k)$-algebras with residue field $k$, which assigns to such a ring $A$ the set of isomorphism classes of pairs $(\mathcal{X},\tilde\rho)$ where $\mathcal{X}$ is a smooth proper relative curve over $\mathrm{Spec}\,A$ equipped with a $G$-action $\tilde\rho$, together with a $G$-equivariant isomorphism of the special fiber with $(X,\rho)$. This functor admits a versal deformation ring (hull) $R(X,\rho)$, a complete local Noetherian $W(k)$-algebra. Define the characteristic 
$$\nu(X,\rho)=\mathrm{char}\big(R(X,\rho)/\mathfrak{m}_{R(X,\rho)}^{\,?}\big)$$
to be the characteristic of $R(X,\rho)$, viewed as an element of $\{0,p,p^2,p^3,\dots\}$ (so $\nu(X,\rho)=0$ if $R(X,\rho)$ has characteristic zero, and $\nu(X,\rho)=p^n$ if $p^n\cdot 1 = 0$ in $R(X,\rho)$ but $p^{n-1}\cdot 1\neq 0$).

Exhibit an explicit example of a pair $(X,\rho)$ as above for which 
$$\nu(X,\rho)=p^n\quad\text{with }1<n<\infty,$$
or prove that no such example exists.
artifact.status_search_result: Web search located related work by Bertin–Mézard and subsequent papers on equivariant deformation rings of curve automorphisms (including computations of universal deformation rings in higher conductor), but did not surface a specific resolution of the question of whether the characteristic of the deformation hull can equal $p^n$ with $1<n<\infty$. The current status appears unverified.

status_evidence.title: Un anneau de deformation universel en conducteur superieur
status_evidence.snippet: Computation of a universal deformation ring for an order-p automorphism with higher Hasse conductor, building on Bertin–Mézard.
status_evidence.claim: Related computations of equivariant deformation rings exist but do not directly address whether nu can equal p^n for 1<n<infinity.

status_evidence.title: The local lifting problem for actions of finite groups on curves
status_evidence.snippet: Survey on lifting and equivariant deformation of curve automorphisms.
status_evidence.claim: Discusses obstructions to lifting but does not record an explicit example with nu(X,rho)=p^n, n>1 finite.
